Maxim Group has issued an update for Apple (NASDAQ:AAPL) shares with a new Hold rating in a research report sent to clients and investors on Wednesday, 30 May. Their TP on the stock is now $200.0000. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Ratings Coverage
Among 36 analysts covering Apple ( NASDAQ:AAPL ), 20 have Buy rating, 0 Sell and 16 Hold. Therefore 56% are positive. Apple has $235 highest and $157 lowest target. $197.52’s average target is 5.34% above currents $187.5 stock price. Apple had 83 analyst reports since December 1, 2017 according to SRatingsIntel. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has “Hold” rating given on Thursday, January 18 by Mizuho. The stock has “Buy” rating by BTIG Research on Tuesday, February 13.
The stock decreased 0.21% or $0.4 $187.5. About 17.03 million shares traded. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has risen 22.56% since May 30, 2017 and is uptrending. It has outperformed by 9.99% the S&P500.
Analysts await Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) to report earnings on August, 7. They expect $2.19 earnings per share, up 31.14 % or $0.52 from last year’s $1.67 per share. AAPL’s profit will be $10.76 billion for 21.40 P/E if the $2.19 EPS becomes a reality. After $2.73 actual earnings per share reported by Apple Inc. for the previous quarter, Wall Street now forecasts -19.78 % negative EPS growth.
Apple Inc. designs, manufactures, and markets mobile communication and media devices, personal computers, and portable digital music players to consumers, small and mid-sized businesses, and education, enterprise, and government clients worldwide. The company has market cap of $921.59 billion. The firm also sells related software, services, accessories, networking solutions, and third-party digital content and applications. It has a 18.14 P/E ratio. It offers iPhone, a line of smartphones; iPad, a line of multi-purpose tablets; and Mac, a line of desktop and portable personal computers.
